description: Draw a world map colouring countries by a number (sales, population, users, visitors by country). Use country names in any common language or ISO 3166 codes (e.g. 'Japan', 'JP', 'JPN'); unmatched names are listed in the result with 'Did you mean' hints. For regions inside one country use generate_country_map; to show exact numbers beside the map use generate_map_ranking. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

brandTheme.description: Name of a brand theme saved on the user's account (their colours and footer), only when the user asks for their theme. Or "colorblind" for colours that people with colour-vision deficiency can tell apart (anyone can use it).

format.description: png (default) or svg. SVG returns a link to a vector version of the map.

labels.description: Write each area's name, value or both on the map (default none). Labels that don't fit are left out.

name: generate_world_map
title: World map
